description: Northern Provincial Council - Cancellation notice of the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1979/26 of 09.08.2016 and published the Northern Province Road Passengers Transport Authority Statute, No. 01 of 2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the establishment and legal framework of the Northern Province Road Passenger Transport Authority through a provincial statute. It contains the full text of the statute, including its objects, establishment details, and constitutional provisions for its management board. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves the creation of new regulations and statutory instruments for passenger transport services in the Northern Province.
